meta..write: newData.exists() && newData.child('phase').isString() && (newData.child('phase').val() === 'lobby' || newData.child('phase').val() === 'question' || newData.child('phase').val() === 'reveal' || newData.child('phase').val() === 'break' || newData.child('phase').val() === 'final' || newData.child('phase').val() === 'sudden_death') && (!newData.child('currentQuestionIndex').exists() || newData.child('currentQuestionIndex').isNumber() || newData.child('currentQuestionIndex').val() === null) && (!newData.child('currentRound').exists() || newData.child('currentRound').isNumber() || newData.child('currentRound').val() === 'suddenDeath' || newData.child('currentRound').val() === null) && (!newData.child('questionStartedAt').exists() || newData.child('questionStartedAt').isNumber() || newData.child('questionStartedAt').val() === null)

$teamId..write: newData.exists() && newData.child('teamName').isString() && newData.child('teamName').val().length > 0 && newData.child('playerCount').isNumber() && newData.child('playerCount').val() >= 1 && newData.child('playerCount').val() <= 4 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('cumulativeLockMs').isNumber() && newData.child('cumulativeLockMs').val() >= 0 && newData.child('isActive').isBoolean()

$questionId..write: newData.exists() && root.child('games/' + $gameCode + '/teams/' + $teamId).exists() && newData.child('teamId').val() === $teamId && newData.child('questionIndex').isNumber() && newData.child('questionIndex').val() >= 1 && newData.child('questionIndex').val() <= 31 && (newData.child('choiceIndex').val() === null || (newData.child('choiceIndex').isNumber() && newData.child('choiceIndex').val() >= 0 && newData.child('choiceIndex').val() <= 3)) && newData.child('pointsAwarded').isNumber() && newData.child('pointsAwarded').val() >= 0
